sanchi_stupa_investigation.finding: Sanchi Stupa is verified as an in-catalog canonical monument (specimens split_d_035 through split_d_040).
sanchi_stupa_investigation.reconciliation: The Phase 8.4 prose report text inadvertently mentioned Sanchi Stupa in section 3.1 narrative under out-of-catalog examples. However, the Split D dataset manifest, FAISS index, and evaluator pipeline strictly and correctly treated Sanchi Stupa as in-catalog. No relabeling is necessary.
